projectMemory.setup: uv venv --python 3.12 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python projectmem && .venv/bin/pjm init

notes: Agents must use this file before inventing validation commands.
Run the smallest set that covers the change — see AGENTS.md §5.
typecheck is null on purpose: Swift and Kotlin type-check as part of their build.
A change to packages/design-tokens must be followed by `pnpm tokens:sync`, and the regenerated app copies committed in the same change.
A change a user can see also owes a simulator or emulator screenshot — see AGENTS.md §6.

After every wave of parallel agents, run `pnpm clean:builds`. `git worktree remove` deletes the checkout and nothing else; each worktree also leaves ~1.5 GB of Xcode DerivedData outside the repository that no git command touches. See AGENTS.md §9.

ios.build: cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -project StoryArc.xcodeproj -scheme StoryArc -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -quiet
ios.screenshot: xcrun simctl io booted screenshot shot.png
notes: swift test runs the pure-Swift targets on the host — no simulator needed.
StoryArc.xcodeproj is generated from project.yml and gitignored. Never hand-edit it.

swiftlint runs from the repository root on purpose. `cd apps/ios` first and it stops finding .swiftlint.yml, falls back to the default rule set, and reports hundreds of violations for rules this project disables on purpose.
pnpm gradle <task> resolves JDK 21 and the SDK itself, and writes the gitignored local.properties a fresh worktree lacks. See scripts/gradle.mjs.
A bare ./gradlew needs JAVA_HOME exported: the wrapper needs a JVM before it can read a property file, and macOS ships a /usr/bin/java stub that shadows a keg-only Homebrew JDK.
Scope to :<module> rather than running the whole build for a single-module change.
